sections.title: Source freshness
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,row_count,freshness from dataset_health order by code

sections.title: Preparation runs
sections.sql: select code,owner,status,freshness,input_count,output_count,error from run_health order by code

sections.title: Review actions
sections.sql: select title,owner,due,days_overdue from attention_queue order by due,title

sections.title: Results and exceptions
sections.sql: select p.code,r.status,r.input_count,r.output_count,r.error,r.created_at from runs r join pipelines p on p.id=r.pipeline_id order by r.created_at desc
